uncited: **Sim(3) Initialization:** Compute a Sim(3) transformation matrix $T_{\text{sim3}}$ using Procrustes analysis on the camera pose locations (centers) of the training images.
Apply this transformation to the estimated test poses: $P_{\text{test}}^{\text{init}} = T_{\text{sim3}} \cdot P_{\text{test}}$.

**Test-time Optimization:** Optimize the parameters of $P_{\text{test}}^{\text{init}}$ by minimizing the photometric loss $\mathcal{L}_{\text{photo}}$ between rendered images and ground truth test images.
A variant using specific initialization schemes for direction vectors.
Fixed initialization sets all initial directions to [Center, Above, Center] (North pole).
When optimizing poses in SO(3), predicted camera locations are overwritten using $t_i = -R_i \times T_i$.
- **Time Complexity:** Depends on the number of optimization iterations and the cost of rendering per iteration.
